definitions.explanation: Refers to each individual room in a building, hotel, house, etc. Common in descriptions of facilities, amenities, or rules that apply to every room.

examples.japanese: {各部屋|かくへや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is an air conditioner in each room.

examples.japanese: {各部屋|かくへや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦フロント→フロント：01378_furonto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}って→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please pick up the keys for each room at the front desk.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{各部屋|かくへや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{専用|せんよう}→専用：12385_senyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バルコニー→バルコニー：06772_barukonii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: This hotel has a private balcony attached to each room.

notes:
Prefix ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧ (each) + ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧ (room). The prefix ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧ attaches to nouns to mean 'each' or 'every,' typically referring to distinct units.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各部屋|かくへや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is ~ in each room
- {各部屋|かくへや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{備|そな}え{付|つ}けられて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: provided in each room
- {各部屋|かくへや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{広|ひろ}さ→広さ：00105_hirosa⟧: the size of each room

SIMILAR PATTERNS:
The ⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧ prefix appears in many similar compounds:
- ⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧: each country
- ⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧: each area
- ⟦{各自|かくじ}→各自：00157_kakuji⟧: each person
